en.title: bendamustine: Highlights, Use in Specific Populations and 8.7 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Highlights, Use in Specific Populations reads “2.5-1.0 x ULN”. 8.7 reads “2.5 to 10 times upper limit of normal (ULN)”. Example: For a patient with AST 5 times ULN and bilirubin 2 times ULN, the Highlights range is empty and expresses no limit; 8.7 covers the case. The same text is in 2 labels from 2 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
